svg.text: claudia — menus that show what fits · 1 · Hiding or greying (D1600, D1603, D1606)
The same menu with each reason at “hide” and at “grey”. For the trial every reason starts at hide; the developer setting switches one reason at a time. Nothing built yet.
Everything in Insert fits: she may change the document.
B · A viewer, role at hide
Nothing in Insert fits a viewer. The title stays (Insert never
disappears); the menu shows one greyed line saying why.
Nothing to insert: you can only look at this document.
C · A viewer, role at grey
Every entry is shown and greyed. Her shortcuts give the same notice as
D · The owner of a new text, nothing selected, nothing done yet: Edit at hide and at grey

Selection and document state are reasons too (D1601): nothing to undo, nothing selected, no objects. At hide the menu changes shape while she works; at grey it keeps its shape. That is what the trial compares.
Hidden: Undo and Redo (nothing to undo), Copy,
Cut and Name & Describe… (nothing selected), the
object steps (no objects). Paste and Paste As
need only her role, so they stay.
Greyed instead, same reasons. The menu keeps its
shape from one moment to the next.
